│ Projects                             │┃ Move the blog to plain files                             ┃
│> Move the blog to plain files ○3 ✓1  │┃> ▾ ○ Export posts from the old CMS ≡ [1/3]               ┃
│   Replace the kitchen faucet ○3 ✓0   │┃                                                         1┃
│   Plan the Lisbon trip ○31 ✓0        │┃       Export plan                                        ┃
│                                      │┃                                                          ┃
│                                      │┃       The old CMS stores posts as HTML fragments in a    ┃
│                                      │┃       single table, with images referenced by absolute   ┃
│                                      │┃       URLs. The export has to keep every published URL   ┃
│                                      │┃       working, because search engines and a few old      ┃
│                                      │┃       forum threads still link to them. Drafts are not   ┃
│                                      │┃       exported. They stay in the database dump in case   ┃
│                                      │┃       one is worth finishing.                            ┃
│                                      │┃                                                          ┃
│                                      │┃       ▌ Steps                                            ┃
│                                      │┃                                                          ┃
│                                      │┃       1. Dump the database from the read replica, never  ┃
│                                      │┃          the primary.                                    ┃
│                                      │┃       2. Convert each fragment to markdown with the      ┃
│                                      │┃          script below.                                   ┃
│                                      │┃       3. Download every image the posts reference into   ┃
│                                      │┃          static/images/<year>/<slug>/.                   ┃
│                                      │┃       4. Rewrite the image links to the new relative     ┃
│                                      │┃          paths.                                          ┃
│                                      │┃       5. Diff a sample of twenty rendered posts against  ┃
│                                      │┃          the live site.                                  ┃
│                                      │┃ 1/7                                                      ┃
╰──────────────────────────────────────╯┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛
